build_DISTS_metric: build a DeepImageStructureTextureSimilarity metric instance with mean reduction for image quality assessment
update_DISTS_with_images: update the DISTS metric with two normalized image tensors of shape N 3 H W
compute_DISTS_score: compute the final DISTS perceptual similarity score using mean or sum reduction
review_NoTrainDists_class: review the NoTrainDists class that overrides train to keep the network in evaluation mode
test_valid_img_check: test the _valid_img function to verify input tensors are 4D 3-channel images normalized to 0-1
